error[L0346]: a C record cannot hold `offset`: `vector2` is not `layout(c)`

  |
7 |     offset: vector2
  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/c-signature-over-a-refused-record/program.ldn:6:26

6 | camera: type = layout(c) struct
  |                          ^^^^^^ this C layout
  = note: [0750]: a layout(c) record holds a record by value only when that one is `layout(c)` too; declare `vector2: type = layout(c) struct`, or hold `ptr vector2` [1580]
